observations.text: The speaker refers to their career as 'playing with toys' and needing to explain their work to others to be left alone.
observations.quote: You were over minding your own fucking business playing with your toys. And somebody was like, what in the fuck are you doing? And you were like, ugh. And then you had to explain.

observations.text: The speaker believes they must be aggressive in their work to avoid being perceived as wrong by others.
observations.quote: Every time you bump up against someone, you become what they perceive you to be. Stop fucking doing that.

observations.text: The speaker states they want to collaborate on a fitness app but feels they lack money and attention from others.
observations.quote: I am actually a developer who is actually working on a fitness app, which is actually going to integrate with your application. I would actually like to collaborate. They could actually say go fuck yourself.

observations.text: The speaker plans to update their project every Friday and Sunday for the next four weeks.
observations.quote: We can do that every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday for the next four Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays.

observations.text: The speaker mentions spending hours on a project involving people clicking a second link.
